name: Switcher
description: Children sit side by side until the container is narrower than a threshold, then all stack at once.

customProperties.name: --switcher-threshold
customProperties.description: Container width below which children stack. Set inline, e.g. style="--switcher-threshold: 40rem".

whenToUse: Two to four items of equal importance, such as pricing tiers or steps, that should switch from a row to a column all at once.
whenNotToUse: Five or more items, or a list of unknown length: use `l-grid` with l-grid--responsive.

do.text: Set the threshold with the custom property.
